message:
fix(apk, sh-strength r6): output tokens unique across renderers; a frame's first show counts whichever of its buffers shows it

Codex codex_sh_strength_r5.md N1-a, N1-b.
a) SharpenOutputLog takes its timestamps from ONE process-wide counter: renderer A (released) and B (current) never
   hand out the same token, so A's late latch looked up in B's log is not found -- never read as B's buffer.
b) SharpenLatch.qualify, the call the Activity makes: a decoded frame's FIRST time on screen is the first latch of
   any of its buffers (its VIDEO, or a REDRAW of it when the VIDEO was never latched) and counts once (first output,
   the selection's frame, its handoff->latch delay); later latches of the same frame are redraws. A cleared or
   unknown buffer is no picture and shows NO layout (NONE_SHOWN: the input fence holds) -- the previous proof is
   not kept for it.
